inputs.description: The Architect's logical contract (service_backed, layers, persistence_invariants) the DBA physically realizes , NOT re-authored. Feature-scoped: the {feature} placeholder expands to the run's feature id (the real on-disk location, features/<F>/architecture.json).

db-design.schema.json — the contract db-design.json is gated against (dbDesignConformant) and that the spec-gate conformance guard reads for column ownership. Requires feature_id; conform to it exactly.

outputs.description: The physical schema (tables + per-story schema_changes + realizes_invariants). dbDesignConformant gates it against db-design.schema.json AT the turn (required feature_id) when the DBA runs, so a shape deviation fails here with a clear error instead of a late conformance-guard block. A non-persisting / non-service-backed feature runs no DBA step at all (designArtifactExpectation returns null), so this validator only applies to a real db-design the DBA actually wrote.
The DBA's structured log of the physical schema it realized.
